name: 子彈時間
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / reference-guided composition.
Create ONE minimal white transparent game HUD icon for the ability BULLET TIME.

REFERENCE ROLES, CRITICAL:
- Image 1 is COMPOSITION AND FROZEN-BULLET SPATIAL REFERENCE ONLY: many bullets have flown toward a central presence and are now suspended, motionless, at different distances in front of it. REMOVE THE HUMAN COMPLETELY. Do not draw that person or invent any replacement person.
- Image 2 is the EXACT EYE-DESIGN REFERENCE: reuse the sharp narrow pair of eyes, angled upper eyelids, pointed inner corners, iris/pupil cutouts and thin lower eye strokes seen in this image. REMOVE the pistol and ALL smoke from this image.

FINAL SUBJECT: The center contains ONLY THAT PAIR OF FLOATING SHARP EYES, with many stopped bullets suspended in the surrounding foreground. The eyes themselves replace the entire central person in image 1. There is NO central body silhouette, NO face outline, NO forehead, NO head, NO nose, NO mouth, NO sunglasses, NO hand, NO coat, NO character. There is NO weapon, pistol, gun barrel, smoke, flame or muzzle flash anywhere.

Composition: square standalone HUD emblem, roughly 78 percent canvas occupancy, comfortable clear margins. A large horizontally spread pair of sharp eyes is centered in the upper-middle band, occupying about 58 percent of canvas width and visually dominating the icon. Around and below the eyes arrange approximately 12 separately readable bullets in a loose 3D foreground field, with a few above and alongside. Bullets at the far left and right angle toward the central empty area below the eyes, bullets closer to the foreground have slightly larger silhouettes, and 2 or 3 foreshortened bullet noses convey depth. Make every projectile clearly a bullet using a thick pointed or rounded ogive tip and a short simple body. They have visibly HALTED before reaching the central eyes. All bullet noses stop outside a clean central exclusion gap, with no contact or impact. Keep eyes unobscured and give each bullet generous transparent separation. Bullets should feel suspended in an invisible field like image 1, not a uniform radial sunburst, not eyelashes, not teardrops, not a fan of speed lines. Avoid perfect circular arrangement. No blur and no long motion trails: frozen stillness with varied perspective.

Style: very simple, bold, flat PURE WHITE pictogram using solid shapes and large transparent negative spaces, coherent with a minimalist Overwatch-inspired ability icon family. Elegant sharp eye shapes matching image 2. Simplify projectile detail strongly, only one transparent separator near each bullet base if needed. White monochrome only, no gray, no colors, no shading, no 3D rendering, no realistic metal. Genuinely transparent background and transparent cutouts. Pristine smooth graphic edges, no grit, no grunge, no speckles, no scratch lines, no shadow, no glow, no texture. No text, letters, numbers, badge, clock, pause symbol or surrounding frame. Central subject is EYES ONLY.
